coverage_definition: Main successful syntheses of JBIR-141 and four analogues, including three fragment preparations in available SI. Known S1/S3/S11 bound upstream coverage; unisolated internal graphs explicitly inferred and analytical degradation products left unassigned.

hrms_checks.graph_scope: Neutral parent for source hydrochloride S2
hrms_checks.label: S2

issues.detail: Primary canonical graphs use main source-drawn ring-enol forms; SI pages 21 and 26 draw alternate exocyclic enols for 1a/1c, retained as canonical alternate representations. No tautomer collapse or unique solution-species assertion.
issues.subject: 1a/1c/5a/5b/1b

issues.detail: Authors report no C25 epimerization by comparison/UPLC; retain source configuration but independent stereochemical review remains pending.
issues.subject: C25

issues.detail: Unisolated acid, protected amide, amino alcohol, deprotected beta-ketoamide, tetramic and nitroso graphs interpret explicit operations. No individual yields assigned.
issues.subject: internal stages

issues.detail: Known precursors are cited to earlier literature; their upstream preparations are not in this dataset.
issues.subject: S1/S3/S11

issues.detail: Main prose says potassium carbonate, while main scheme and all SI procedures specify sodium carbonate; record sodium carbonate with discrepancy.
issues.subject: 13 deprotection

issues.detail: SI page 24 scheme calls acid 14c; procedure and earlier preparation identify 14b. Route follows 14b.
issues.subject: 15c

issues.detail: Main and SI schemes report 20% over four steps; SI isolation paragraph says 67% with unresolved denominator. Half of crude sample proceeds to final step. Do not allocate 67% to an individual stage.
issues.subject: 1c

issues.detail: Only fractions of crude nitroso material proceed to final hydrogenolysis; preserve source yields and fractions, no batch-wide extrapolation.
issues.subject: 5a/5b/1b/1c

issues.detail: SI gives 1.09 mmol of 8 from 1.03 mmol S11 and describes quantitative yield. Retain qualitative yield; do not calculate >100%.
Several scheme/procedure durations differ: acylation 10 h vs 15 h, 5a nitrosation 2 h vs 1 h, 1c cyclization 8 vs 10 min and nitrosation 1 vs 2 h. Conditions not fully normalized.
issues.subject: 10/5a/1c

issues.detail: SI acid-stability experiment reports hydrolysis without fully assigned product structure/yield; retained as analytical metadata, not a preparative target branch.
issues.subject: 1a

issues.detail: Specific rotation changes after silica short-pass; authors suggest different zwitterion/tautomer populations. Record source graphs without asserting identity from rotation alone.
issues.subject: 1a
